[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Juri Marbra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the fiancé of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] singer [[Saahir Ru'luv]], as well as a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. Together, Marbra and Ru'luv ran a gunrunning operations for the Rebellion and on their last mission for the Rebellion before their deaths, they hired Saahir's true love, [[Thaddeus Ross]], and [[Trep Winterrs]] to haul a munitions cargo including 500 [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] aboard the ''[[Kierra]]'' to a hidden Rebel base.<ref name="LAD" />
